name: Chris Kanu
source:
By day the cool, mysterious and beautiful school idol of Minkei Academy but [spoiler]is really one of the four "Royal Slave Knights" of Mu. Her duty is mainly maintaining the well-being of the king, including even the king’s lower half needs. As she reveals her identity, she also softens up in character. Appearing to become more of a civil servant who appeases the king and takes everything [url=/c921]Ryuu[/url] says beyond the realms of common sense. Perhaps something in the past led to her clinginess, as she seemed to be afraid of "letting Ryuu go again".

One of the Royal Slave Knights and is known to the Maya Federation as the "Godspeed Lancer" aka "Sky Lancer".  Among the slaves, she has the lowest priority number for assassination as number 7, but nevertheless she's still fairly strong.
She went to Japan supposedly to ascertain Ryuu's location and to bring him back, but given the strange way he acted, she decided to infiltrate Minkei Academy to be closer to him. Before long she became one of Minkei Academy's three great idols.

Due to the Mother's Bathing effect of her Miracle, the "Elephant's Record", she's fit for fending off the attacks of the Maya Union's normal soldiers. She's basically Ryuu's escort. According to her, she's still inexperienced at serving in bed, so she's probably a virgin. Her character can be described as a worrywart and she doesn't have common sense. With only 2016 years as her age she is probably the youngest among the Royal Slave Knights.[/spoiler]

[spoiler]Maya Union assassination target with the priority number of 7[/spoiler]
[Edited from a [url=http://whatistomato.wordpress.com/2011/06/16/edensaishuusensoushoujodensetsu/]preview[/url] by Warum]
